title: Among all posts created in 2010 and tagged with '<humor>', compute the perc
question: Among all posts created in 2010 and tagged with '<humor>', compute the percentage that are well-finished (i.e., have a non-null ClosedDate). Additionally, report the total number of such posts, the average view count, and how many of them have above-average view counts compared to all posts in the database.

prediction.sql:
WITH all_posts_avg AS (
    SELECT AVG(XCL_030) AS avg_views
    FROM posts
),
filtered_posts AS (
    SELECT 
        p.XCL_026,
        p.XCL_030,
        p.XCL_044
    FROM posts p
    WHERE strftime('%Y', p.XCL_029) = '2010'
      AND p.XCL_036 LIKE '%<humor>%'
)
SELECT 
    (COUNT(CASE WHEN fp.XCL_044 IS NOT NULL THEN 1 END) * 100.0 / COUNT(fp.XCL_026)) AS percentage_closed
FROM filtered_posts fp
CROSS JOIN all_posts_avg apa

WITH all_posts_avg AS (
    SELECT AVG(XCL_030) AS avg_views
    FROM posts
),
filtered_posts AS (
    SELECT 
        p.XCL_026,
        p.XCL_030,
        p.XCL_044
    FROM posts p
    WHERE strftime('%Y', p.XCL_029) = '2010'
      AND p.XCL_036 LIKE '%<humor>%'
)
SELECT 
    (COUNT(CASE WHEN fp.XCL_044 IS NOT NULL THEN 1 END) * 100.0 / COUNT(fp.XCL_026)) AS percentage_closed,
    COUNT(fp.XCL_026) AS total_posts,
    AVG(fp.XCL_030) AS average_view_count,
    COUNT(CASE WHEN fp.XCL_030 > apa.avg_views THEN 1 END) AS above_average_count
FROM filtered_posts fp
CROSS JOIN all_posts_avg apa

WITH all_posts_avg AS (
    SELECT AVG(XCL_030) AS avg_views
    FROM posts
),
filtered_posts AS (
    SELECT 
        p.XCL_026,
        p.XCL_030,
        p.XCL_044
    FROM posts p
    WHERE strftime('%Y', p.XCL_029) = '2010'
      AND p.XCL_036 LIKE '%<humor>%'
)
SELECT 
    (COUNT(CASE WHEN fp.XCL_044 IS NOT NULL THEN 1 END) * 100.0 / COUNT(fp.XCL_026)) AS percentage_closed
FROM filtered_posts fp
CROSS JOIN all_posts_avg apa
